headline.zh: 近10种精品阿拉比卡豆可选

traits.en: Offers nearly 10 specialty Arabica beans at once

traits.en: Winter drinks include almond milk and apple cinnamon lattes

traits.zh: 提供带葡萄蓝莓或焦糖 topping 的蛋糕
traits.en: Serves cakes topped with berries or caramel

traits.zh: 至少有4个木质扶手椅配小圆桌座位
traits.en: At least 4 seats with wooden armchairs and small round tables

adventure.zh: 多款特调与频繁更换豆单
adventure.en: Rotating beans and unique seasonal drinks

linger.zh: 有小桌椅但座位数有限
